'''Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War''' is a planned Players Committee Virtual Set of the Original era that was never released. It is a different product from the modern [[Virtual Set 19]] (Current Virtual, August 2022). The cancellation is covered on [[Cancelled Virtual Sets]] (&sect; Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War).
